# CANDIDATE: STRUCTURE_BOS_RETEST_WITH_VWAP_HOLD_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a break of structure (BOS) to the upside, a retest that holds above VWAP signals the new support is reliable, offering a low-risk long entry. This edge exists because BOS indicates a shift in market structure, and a VWAP-held retest confirms institutional buying interest at the new support level, increasing the probability of continuation.

## Mechanism

Identify a bullish BOS when price makes a new high exceeding the prior swing high and takes out the prior swing low (classic BOS). Wait for price to pull back to the broken swing low (now acting as support). Enter long when the 5-minute close is above VWAP, the low of the pullback bar is ≥ the broken swing low (no close below it), and the 8-EMA > 21-EMA (ribbon still bullish). Exit: stop placed just below the pulled-back low (chart-stop), TP1 at 1.6× risk, remainder trailed with a chandelier exit (ATR×2.5) or 12% off the highest-since-entry price.
